projects.name: MASS — Multi-Agent Startup Simulator
projects.description: A multi-agent AI system that stress-tests a startup idea and turns it into a concrete build plan. Five agent personas (CEO, Finance, Marketing, Product, Sales) debate the plan while a Supervisor enforces consensus; deterministic Python checks on runway, burn and CAC vs LTV trigger a repair pass when the model gets the numbers wrong. Streams the debate live to a Next.js UI over Server-Sent Events.

projects.name: APIx — Real-Time Airfare Price Index for India
projects.description: A daily airfare price index for India's domestic routes, built to complement the monthly CPI airfare figure. Tracks 6 routes across 5 booking windows (30 observations a day), aggregates them with official index formulas (Jevons within routes, Laspeyres across them), and links every published number to a SHA-256-fingerprinted raw response. Ships with a public dashboard, an operator console and an OpenAPI.

projects.name: Rawbin.in — Smart Composter Website
projects.description: The production website for Rawbin, India's first smart home composter. Added a server-side Instagram Graph API proxy for live reels, reworked SEO on the Next.js App Router (dynamic sitemap, JSON-LD schemas, OG images, llms.txt), shipped a PWA manifest and fixed a dark-mode rendering bug across the site.

projects.name: Zero to Modern AI — Gamified AI Learning Platform
projects.description: A multi-user learning platform for modern AI concepts, styled after DataCamp and Duolingo. A path engine renders checkpoints, side quests and project gates; XP, levels and streaks track progress; Supabase handles auth (email and Google) with per-user data isolated through Row-Level Security, plus a one-click import of older offline progress.

projects.name: Delhi NCR AQI Classification Engine
projects.description: A machine learning framework that classifies Delhi NCR air quality into three health-risk tiers (Good, Poor, Bad) from pollutant readings (PM2.5, PM10, NO2, CO) and weather conditions. Moving to XGBoost on harmonised data lifted accuracy from about 57% to about 98%.

projects.name: ML-Enhanced Dynamic MAC Protocol Optimization
projects.context: Team lead · Data Communication & Networks course
projects.description: A SimPy discrete-event simulator that models MAC-layer protocols (Slotted ALOHA, CSMA/CA) with RF propagation delay, node placement and bursty traffic, then uses an ensemble classifier to pick the best protocol in real time as network load changes. Led a team of five.

projects.name: Waffle Da! — Brand Website & App
projects.description: Ordering website and companion mobile app for Waffle Da!, a late-night food brand in Bidholi, Dehradun. A multi-category menu with item customization and order tracking, plus a Supabase-backed admin panel for live menu and order management.

projects.name: Jade — 2D Game Engine in Java
projects.description: A 2D game engine built from scratch in Java: an Entity Component System, OpenGL 3.3 batch rendering with custom GLSL shaders, a Dear ImGui level editor with docking, JBox2D physics and scene serialization.

projects.name: IMC Prosperity Trading Bot
projects.description: An algorithmic trading bot for the IMC Prosperity challenge, with safe mid-price handling for one-sided order books, dynamic execution thresholds and queue-priority logic.
